assets.name: Canton Network

score_rationales.institutional: Canton Network has exceptional institutional depth — Goldman Sachs, BNY Mellon, Nasdaq, S&P Global, DTCC, Franklin Templeton, and 600+ institutions active on-chain with $6T in RWAs and $339B daily repo volume — but the 21Shares TCAN ETF only launched May 7 2026 (very recent), DTCC full production is not until Oct 2026, and retail/broad custody infrastructure is still early-stage, capping the score below the 90s.
score_rationales.regulatory: Canton Network has achieved rare near-term regulatory clarity: a US-listed ETF (21shares TCAN, Nasdaq, May 2026) launched days ago, DTCC received SEC no-action relief in Dec 2025 for live on-chain Treasury tokenization on Canton, and 600+ regulated institutions (JPMorgan, BlackRock, Gemini, Kraken) operate as validators — collectively making it one of the most institutionally legitimized blockchain networks in any jurisdiction. The primary drag is that the network's enterprise-permissioned architecture means the CANTON token itself has limited precedent as a tradeable asset under securities law, and non-US ETP issuers (21Shares EU) explicitly exclude US/Canada/Australia/Japan distribution, signaling some residual multi-jurisdictional uncertainty.
